channel.title: Kissimmee Artificial Turf blog
channel.description: Straight answers about artificial turf in Central Florida.

item.title: Why is artificial grass installation so expensive?
item.description: Artificial grass installation runs $8-$18 a sq ft in Kissimmee as of September 2026. A line-item table and sample quote show where the money actually goes.

item.title: What should an artificial turf quote include, and how do you compare two?
item.description: Two Kissimmee turf quotes can differ by thousands for the same yard. A five-spec checklist, the 2026 state rule and a side-by-side sample show what to compare.

item.title: Is artificial turf cheaper than sod over 10 years in Florida?
item.description: Artificial turf on 1,000 sq ft runs $11,500-$23,000 over 10 years in Central Florida vs. $18,000-$37,000 for St. Augustine sod. Year-by-year table and sources.

item.title: How much does a backyard putting green cost in Florida?
item.description: A backyard putting green costs $14-$30 a sq ft installed in Central Florida as of September 2026. Size-based tables for 200, 400 and 800 sq ft, plus add-on pricing.

item.title: Does artificial grass increase home value in Florida?
item.description: Does artificial grass raise resale value in Florida? No state study puts a number on it as of September 2026. Here's what NAR's outdoor remodeling data shows.

item.title: DIY artificial turf installation or hire a contractor?
item.description: DIY artificial turf materials run $3.50-$9 a sq ft plus base and tool rental, versus Florida's $8-$18 installed range. Where sandy soil causes DIY installs to fail.

item.title: How do you choose the best artificial turf contractor in Kissimmee?
item.description: Choosing an artificial turf contractor in Kissimmee means checking base spec, seams, drainage, HOA paperwork, insurance and a tax receipt. A full 2026 checklist.

item.title: How do you find the best artificial grass installer near you?
item.description: How to vet the best artificial grass installer near you: read reviews for specifics, check seam photos, run a Sunbiz and DBPR lookup, and verify insurance directly.

item.title: What does an artificial turf warranty actually cover?
item.description: Artificial turf warranties run 8-15 years and cover UV fade, not reflective heat damage. How proration works, and product vs. workmanship terms in 2026.

item.title: When is the right time of year to install artificial turf in Central Florida?
item.description: NOAA's 1991-2020 climate normals show Kissimmee's driest months are November through April. A month-by-month rainfall table for planning an artificial turf install.
